prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: transparent eight-pose staff-character source sheet for review
Primary request: Create one cohesive rounded full-body pixel-art sheet for the pharmacist employee in Image2. Image1 controls the established same-role uniform cues, pixel-art style, proportional scale and eight-pose layout. Image2 controls the NEW identity and every uniform detail: a 58-year-old adult woman with fair skin, straight warm-brown jaw-length asymmetrical bob with one smooth silver side panel, small teal oval glasses, and a full-figured build. They wear a knee-above-length white full-sleeved pharmacist coat with lapels and two large lower patch pockets over a muted-sage collared blouse, dark-charcoal trousers and black loafers; no cap. Preserve every detail across all eight views.
Composition/framing: exactly two rows of four isolated full-body figures. Top left-to-right: standing SOUTH/front, EAST/true profile facing screen-right, WEST/true profile facing screen-left, NORTH/rear. Bottom same order: seated SOUTH/EAST/WEST/NORTH. Broad transparent gutters, generous row gap and outer margins; every head and shoe fully visible well away from canvas edges. Seated figures sit on invisible chairs, knees bent around 90 degrees, hands naturally on thighs, feet flat; no chair visible. Same head/body scale and proportions in standing and seated views. Coat or jacket sleeves remain full length to the wrists in ALL views, including the seated rear view. No hat, surgical cap or headwear. Pockets, collar, badge placement and garment hems stay consistent; coats/jackets rest naturally while seated.
Style/medium: Compact rounded proportions, large expressive head, clean dark pixel-stepped outline, restrained two/three-tone cel shading and crisp softly shaded pixel-art finish exactly matching the existing role art in Image1 and the accepted v6a/v6b cohort. Do not make a taller, realistic, glossy, vector-flat or photorealistic figure.
Constraints: genuine transparent RGBA background; no chair, furniture, floor, cast shadow, glow, held equipment, scenery, text, readable badge, logos, watermarks, labels, grid, missing/duplicate/cropped poses. A described badge stays blank. No stethoscope, needle, test tube, medication or tool.
